included_steps: Validate main-writer coordination and push recovery
Derive the shard map from the validation matrix
The coverage gate must fail when coverage is lost
A cached built tree must not overwrite the commit's own workflows
A displaced scheduled lane must be requeued, once, without displacing another
The parity manifest must keep node_modules out whatever shape it has
Recover the receipt from the cached tree
Publish the ordered build job's receipt
Two isolated clean rebuilds must agree
Executed validator set must equal the declared validator set
Hand the validated commit to its workflow_run consumers
assertions: success artifact name matches deploy workflow expectation
